cards.name: Shaper Apprentice
cards.oracleText: This creature has flying as long as you control another Merfolk.

cards.name: Shape of the Wiitigo
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, put six +1/+1 counters on enchanted creature.
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+1 counter on enchanted creature if it attacked or blocked since your last upkeep. Otherwise, remove a +1/+1 counter from it.

cards.name: Shape Stealer
cards.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, change this creature's base power and toughness to that creature's power and toughness until end of turn.

cards.name: Shaper Guildmage
cards.oracleText:
{W}, {T}: Target creature gains first strike until end of turn.
{B}, {T}: Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Shapeshifter
cards.oracleText:
As this creature enters, choose a number between 0 and 7.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may choose a number between 0 and 7.
Shapeshifter's power is equal to the last chosen number and its toughness is equal to 7 minus that number.

cards.name: Shapeshifter's Marrow
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that player reveals the top card of their library. If it's a creature card, the player puts the card into their graveyard and this enchantment becomes a copy of that card. (If it does, it loses this ability.)

cards.name: Shapesharer
cards.oracleText:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
{2}{U}: Target Shapeshifter becomes a copy of target creature until your next turn.

cards.name: Shape the Sands
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +0/+5 and gains reach until end of turn. (It can block creatures with flying.)

cards.name: Shapers of Nature
cards.oracleText:
{3}{G}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
{2}{U}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Draw a card.

cards.name: Shaper Parasite
cards.oracleText:
Morph {2}{U} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.)
When this creature is turned face up, target creature gets +2/-2 or -2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Shape Anew
cards.oracleText: The controller of target artifact sacrifices it, then reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal an artifact card. That player puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles all other cards revealed this way into their library.

cards.name: Shapers' Sanctuary
cards.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw a card.
